items.title: Rob Mounsey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 9, 2025
items.q: Cavaquinhos and the different banjos, the tenor banjo, the five string banjo, the pedal steel.

ctx.x: Cavaquinhos and the different banjos, the tenor banjo, the five string banjo, the pedal steel. And so they collect the microphones and the pre-amps and they can do everything at home now and a lot of playing musicians are very, very adept at all of that and they can do great work at home.
I know Randy Brecker mentioned that, things in the mail and overdubbed solos.
